purpose: Human DMD point-mutation cardiac-organoid series for the Stage 2 gene axis genetic_cardiomyopathy category (ADR 0066): DMD patient-derived hiPSC cardiac organoids at day 56 (3 libraries) and the same line after CRISPR/Cas correction (3 libraries). The item-local derivation fits the single DMD-vs-corrected contrast; the deposit is the low-priority DMD arm of the category.

sources.method: script/fetch.sh (curl from the GEO FTP: GSE194297_DMD_vs_DMD-Iso.absolute_counts.csv.gz and GSE194297_series_matrix.txt.gz, byte-size pinned; no other payload fetched)

local_additions.origin: item-local fit input: source_gene_id, gene_symbol and one count column per library (feature x sample), handed to output/api/bases/disease_deg.R; regenerable, never tracked (item .gitignore)
item-local fit design sheet: sample, group, declared blocking covariates, gsm and title, in matrix column order; regenerable, never tracked (item .gitignore)
item-local full DEG table: one row per tested gene and contrast (29,911 rows, 29,911 source genes); regenerable, never tracked (item .gitignore)

tracked compact DEG summary: deposit digests, sample mapping basis, the isogenic-control record, the strata/pooling decision, the one-joint design and its contrasts with n_case/n_control, integerisation statistics (when used), limma/R versions and output digest
ADR 0030 item ignore declaration for the regenerable local/deg matrix, sample-sheet and DEG table (the tracked summary JSON stays in git)

notes: ACCESSION: GSE194297 — DMD point-mutation cardiac organoids vs CRISPR-corrected isogenic line. The deposit is open GEO access; two payloads are stored in source/ (the expression matrix and the GEO series matrix, both byte-size pinned in script/fetch.sh), nothing else is fetched. SAMPLE MAPPING: matrix columns are the GSM title bracket tokens [GC115820]..[GC115825]; the binding is by name (never by position) with a fail-closed bijection check, and every library is matched (no silent drop). DERIVATION: deposited absolute count matrix (semicolon-separated, gene symbols, 29,911 features x 6 libraries, all values integer, library sums 13.9-24.4M), used as deposited by the strict-count voom path. DESIGN: one joint limma-voom fit ~0 + group over all 6 organoid libraries; single contrast DMD-DMD_corrected. ISOGENIC EXCEPTION: Single time point (day 56) and single case/control pair; no stratum to pool. The adapter is the single shared derivation stage2/01_bases/output/api/bases/bulk_deg.py and the single live DEG implementation output/api/bases/disease_deg.R (limma 3.62.2; R version 4.4.1 (2024-06-14)); the item script only binds its deposited bytes and its declared design. PUBLISHED: one item-local full DEG table and the tracked summary here; the step's output/disease-deg/genetic_cardiomyopathy/ publishes the compact table and within-dataset rank per source dataset (ticket #188, not the item). CONTRASTS: DMD-DMD_corrected (3 case / 3 control). BUILD: capped at 10 GiB RLIMIT_AS, OMP_NUM_THREADS=2; peak RSS 168,200 KiB, wall 1.4 s; a second independent run reproduced the DEG table byte-identically. REPRODUCTION: script/fetch.sh -> script/verify.sh -> script/build_deg.py.
